title: Shift Swap Checklist Form
subtitle: Use this checklist to verify readiness and execution, expose failed checkpoints, authorize the next state, and preserve accountable handoff for a shift swap workflow.
description: An original operational shift swap checklist form that controls a paired schedule-change and coverage record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the requesting workers, scheduler, or shift manager needs a traceable checklist so the authorized scheduling, payroll, operations, or HR reviewer can approve, conditionally approve, deny, cancel, reverse, or correct the proposed shift exchange under the current schedule, role-qualification matrix, rest and overtime rules, labor agreement, and applicable scheduling policy without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Shift Swap checklist assignment and operating boundary
sections.guidance: Identify the event, accountable operator, reviewer, applicable references, and required completion point.

blocks.label: Event scope, operating objective, affected population, exclusions, and required outcome

sections.title: Shift Swap readiness and source-record verification
sections.guidance: Confirm the task is ready and the operator has the correct information before checking execution.

blocks.label: Shift Swap readiness checks
items: Both workers and their employee references are verified
Original shift dates, times, zones, roles, and locations match the schedule
Proposed segments account for the full exchanged time
Role qualifications, credentials, access, and supervision remain sufficient
Coverage and skill mix are maintained for both affected shifts
Rest, consecutive-work, fatigue, and scheduling limits are reviewed
Overtime, premium, differential, and labor-agreement impacts are calculated
Both workers provided voluntary, current acknowledgment

blocks.label: Source records and evidence available
items: Published original schedule and schedule-period reference
Worker identity, role, qualification, and access records
Paired worker acknowledgments with date and time
Coverage and skill-mix review
Rest, overtime, premium, or agreement-rule check
Manager, scheduler, or second-level decision
Updated scheduling and timekeeping system reference
Cancellation, no-show, correction, or payroll follow-up record

sections.title: Shift Swap execution checkpoints and traceable results
sections.guidance: Record each checkpoint against observable evidence and identify every condition that is not complete.

blocks.label: Shift Swap execution checkpoints
items: Both workers and their employee references are verified
Original shift dates, times, zones, roles, and locations match the schedule
Proposed segments account for the full exchanged time
Role qualifications, credentials, access, and supervision remain sufficient
Coverage and skill mix are maintained for both affected shifts
Rest, consecutive-work, fatigue, and scheduling limits are reviewed
Overtime, premium, differential, and labor-agreement impacts are calculated
Both workers provided voluntary, current acknowledgment
Conflicting leave, training, restriction, or assignment is resolved
Manager and scheduler approvals are captured before the effective time
Schedule and timekeeping systems show matching final assignments
Each worker received confirmation and the cancellation route

blocks.label: Checkpoint, observed evidence, result, operator, and follow-up
Observed conditions, sequence, evidence references, deferred checks, and operating limitations

sections.title: Shift Swap failed checkpoint and escalation control
sections.guidance: Do not hide an incomplete or failed checkpoint inside free text; route it with an owner and due point.

blocks.label: Checklist stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the authorized scheduling, payroll, operations, or HR reviewer under the current schedule, role-qualification matrix, rest and overtime rules, labor agreement, and applicable scheduling policy.

blocks.label: Shift Swap exception and escalation triggers
items: Approved change was not entered or appeared differently in a system
Worker reported to the wrong time, role, unit, or location
No-show or uncovered interval followed the exchange
Worker lacked required qualification, access, or supervision
Rest, fatigue, overtime, premium, or agreement constraint was missed
Worker reports coercion, retaliation, side payment, or false consent
Cancellation or reversal was not communicated to every affected party
Timekeeping or payroll result does not match the approved schedule

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale

sections.title: Shift Swap verification and proceed decision
sections.guidance: Use an independent review where required and state the exact boundary of any proceed decision.

blocks.label: Checklist and qualified-review boundary
blocks.guidance: A completed checkbox is evidence only when the underlying condition was observed. The authorized scheduling, payroll, operations, or HR reviewer must apply the current schedule, role-qualification matrix, rest and overtime rules, labor agreement, and applicable scheduling policy before any restricted, safety, security, legal, medical, payroll, or tax decision.

sections.title: Shift Swap checklist handoff and closeout
sections.guidance: Preserve the final state, unfinished work, receiving owner, and reopen trigger.

blocks.label: Open shift swap action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
